name: Cupid's Confused!?
source:
Cupid spends her day to day life fixing the lives of humans all over the world. However, what will she do when one of her followers requests her aid in falling in love with their work? 

[From [url=https://snatch-gaymes.itch.io/cupids-confused]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
丘比特每天都忙着替世界各地的人解决生活难题。可要是哪位信徒来求她帮忙爱上自己的工作，她又该怎么办？

（来源：[url=https://snatch-gaymes.itch.io/cupids-confused]itch.io[/url]）
